The indirect connection between etoposide and NCI-H630 is supported by the presence of a target relationship between Mollicellin N and NCI-H630, suggesting that the molecular mechanism involves a cascade where etoposide influences the expression or function of Leukocyte common antigen, which then interacts with Mollicellin N to affect NCI-H630.
